asset_manifest.pose: dino_bones_paleontologist_1 (adult female, long blonde hair, white sun hat, khaki safari vest, pink hiking boots) stands over a shallow limestone bedding plane, holding a magnifying glass down toward a sequence of sharp, curved claw drags left on a prehistoric tidal flat.

visual_notes.ichnology: The trackway consists of alternating, narrow crocodylomorph paddle-sweeps and crisp, multi-toed claw scuffs. It features sharp, sunken negative impressions showing distinctive four-clawed patterns with thin sediment displacement ridges along the edges.
visual_notes.ground: Cream white and ivory platy limestone nodules with fine white sand patches, completely devoid of grass.
